title: ux-recast task contract
description: The independent statement of what a flow must achieve. Written before implementation and kept apart from the plan so the review has a yardstick other than the code. Shape identical to the Lugos ux-review task.json.

flow.description: Short name of the user flow.

goal.description: What the person is trying to do, in their terms.

acceptance.description: Observable checks; each should be verifiable from evidence.

device_input.description: Device class and input mode the flow is judged on, e.g. phone, touch.

source.description: Where the task came from: ticket, conversation, document.
